ModuleCarried.name: Xeno-Gear Module
ModuleCarried.SpecificEffects:
DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>24%</color> while equipped with <color=#F74848>2</color> different weapon types.
After an action, the DMG multiplier of the next active attack increases by <color=#F74848>+0.1</color>.

ModuleCarried.name: Stargazer Unit
ModuleCarried.SpecificEffects:
Removes restriction, grants effect: <buf ID=173900>[Mech Form]</buf>: when actively attacking, if Hit Rate is <color=#F74848>90%</color> or more, this attack cannot miss. <buf ID=173901>[Cruise Form]</buf>: Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>, Vision range <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
At the end of turn, if <buf ID=173904>[Configuration Shift]</buf> has been used <color=#F74848>2</color> or more times, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> AP, otherwise gains <color=#F74848>1</color> <buf ID=173903>[Shift Energy]</buf>. When piloted by [Lustre], CP <color=#F74848>+3</color> in the lowest unlocked Neural Drive Sector.
